import pytest
from target import unescapeHTML

def test_none_returns_none():
    assert unescapeHTML(None) is None

def test_non_string_raises_assertion():
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        unescapeHTML(123)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "input_str, expected",
    [
        ("&", "&"),
        ("<div>", "<div>"),
        ("Hello "world"!", 'Hello "world"!'),
        ("No entities here", "No entities here"),
    ],
)
def test_simple_entities(input_str, expected):
    assert unescapeHTML(input_str) == expected

def test_unknown_entity_with_internal_ampersand_is_unchanged():
    # Old implementation would not match this pattern because of the internal '&'
    # New implementation must also leave it unchanged.
    s = "This is &unknown&entity; test"
    assert unescapeHTML(s) == s

def test_mixed_entities_and_unknown_with_internal_ampersand():
    # Only the valid entities should be transformed; the unknown one with an internal '&' stays as‑is.
    s = "Start & middle &unknown&entity; end <tag>."
    expected = "Start & middle &unknown&entity; end <tag>."
    assert unescapeHTML(s) == expected
